jobs.description:
Job ID: 2026-14097 Overview:

*Si ce poste est situé au Canada, veuillez visiter notre site français à l’adresse suivante :* *https://careerscafr-kmbskonicaminolta.icims.com/jobs* *et rechercher le numéro d’emploi indiqué ci-dessus afin de consulter cette offre d’emploi en français.*

Konica Minolta is seeking a highly motivated and strategic Global Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact customer implementations and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role is ideal for a seasoned project leader who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys partnering with global clients, and excels at driving projects from concept through successful delivery.

As a trusted advisor to both customers and internal stakeholders, you will manage large-scale, cross-functional projects that directly influence business outcomes. You will collaborate with executive leadership, technical teams, operations, and customers to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with strategic objectives.

This is a primarily remote position with a preference for candidates located in the Dallas, TX or Memphis, TN metropolitan areas to support key client relationships. Exceptional candidates located elsewhere will also be considered. Periodic travel, typically on a quarterly basis, is expected to support customer engagements, project milestones, and team collaboration.

If you're energized by leading complex initiatives, building strong customer partnerships, and making a measurable impact within a global organization, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

* Establish realistic goals and implement action plans for achieving set objectives
* Guide and direct project team members to ensure compliance with set standards, procedures, and guidelines.
* Ensure availability of financial, material and human resources required to complete a project successfully
* Evaluate the progress of a project to detect limitations or faults to seek solutions to a more efficient process
* Develop internal communication strategies useful in ensuring communication between various stakeholders, departments of an organization
* Use specialized tools and techniques to delegate and ensure even distribution of tasks to project team members
* Participate in educational programs to update job knowledge and expand personal network
* Motivate team members to meet project goals by effectively carrying out their responsibilities
* Offer solutions effective in meeting set targets and satisfying client requirements
* Manage every aspect of a project, including its planning, communication, risk assessment, and resources.

Qualifications:

**Education & Training**

* Bachelor’s Degree in project management or related discipline
* Project Management Certification (PMI PMP/ Prince2 Practitioner PMP and/or Agile and/or Six Sigma certification)

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in people and resource management are essential to the position
* 5+ years of experience in solutions integration, global operations, software development, document management, managed print services, IT operations, or business process management.
* Prior experience managing multi-country programs/projects is highly desirable.
* Proven track record of meeting and exceeding project goals and objectives.

**Leadership & Communication Skills**

* Strong leadership, organizational and interpersonal skills; the ability to work well with people from different disciplines and cultures; competence in clear concise, and tactful communication with senior executive management, clients, peers, and team members.
* Strong writing, mentoring, decision making, communication, and meeting facilitation skills
* Ability to train and mentor junior project managers and operational management teams in project and process management methodologies.
* Leadership Skill: able to direct the operations of a project unit to ensure set goals are achieved

**Project Management & Problem-Solving Skills**

* Knowledge of and competency in project management processes including planning, resource allocation, risk management, time management, financial management, HR management, quality management, monitoring, and reporting, documenting, and record keeping.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project.
* Experience utilizing Smartsheet for project planning, tracking, reporting, and resource management.
* Problem-solving skills: apply project management principles and methodologies in seeking solutions to project problems.
* Can conform to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Adaptability and flexibility to manage deadline pressure, ambiguity, and change.

jobs.description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**Senior Program Manager – Americas**

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world-class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to finding a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**Vertical: Technology (NCR Atleos Account)**

Senior Program Manager - Project & Development Services – Americas

Summary: Join JLL’s Project & Development Services team as a Senior Program Manager, providing program-level oversight of our client’s real estate portfolio across the Americas region. In this pivotal role, you’ll act as a trusted advisor and regional point of contact for the account’s Americas stakeholders, monitoring and directing a portfolio of concurrent projects across multiple countries that are delivered day-to-day by in-country variable PM/CM resource and working closely with regional and global JLL leadership to drive efficiency, consistency, and cost savings across the portfolio. You will assume a lead role in program strategy and execution, own financial management, risk and vendor performance across the program, and lead, mentor and develop the project managers who deliver it. Technology-enabled delivery is central to this role, with JLL’s project management and AI-driven platforms – including Ingenious.Build and JLL Azara – underpinning how consistent, data-led standards are maintained across the account.

**What this job involves:**

* Providing program-level oversight and governance for a portfolio of concurrent projects across multiple countries throughout North, Central and South America, delivered day-to-day by in-country variable PM/CM resource.
* Assuming a lead role in developing and executing portfolio strategies, standardized processes, and reporting tools across programs, including capital plan creation and management
* Championing the adoption of JLL’s technology stack – including Ingenious.Build and AI-driven platforms such as JLL Azara – and working closely with the account’s PMO and Center of Excellence (CoE) to drive consistent global standards
* Acting as trusted advisor to the client, managing relationships and cross-functional partnerships, and leading conflict resolutions
* Overseeing portfolio performance, risk management, and delivery across the full real estate lifecycle – from site selection and design through pre-construction, construction, fit-out and closeout, including programming, entitlements, permitting, bidding, and consultant, contractor and vendor selection
* Leading, supervising, training, mentoring and evaluating project managers at various levels across a national and multi-country platform while contributing to business growth and development efforts.
* Managing performance of contracted vendors and consultants, and identifying and addressing areas of potential liability and risk (e.g., fee, JLL/NCR Atleos reputation, errors and omissions) across the program

**What your day-to-day looks like:**

* Directing and coordinating in-country PM/CM delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones, ensuring consistent standards and escalating issues requiring regional or client-level resolution
* Overseeing consolidated reporting on schedules, budgets, forecasts, cash flow, risks, and opportunities across the portfolio, and communicating analyzed data to the client and project teams to achieve project goals
* Reviewing procurement and financial activity conducted by in-country teams, including RFP/RFQ development, bid evaluation, contract facilitation, budgets (including hard and soft costs), monthly forecasts, cash flow analysis, anticipated cost reports and construction cost/benefit analysis, as required by the client.
* Overseeing delivery of project management fundamentals across the portfolio, including budgeting, scheduling, submittals and change orders
* Managing vendor and project team performance to ensure compliance with contractual requirements, all regulating entities and client expectations
* Leveraging JLL Azara and other AI-enabled reporting tools to surface real-time portfolio insights and support data-led decision-making across the account
* Monitoring compliance with applicable health, safety and regulatory requirements, and ensuring in-country teams maintain accurate project documentation and reporting systems (e.g., Ingenious.Build, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint)
* Communicating with executive-level and client stakeholders, and developing and cultivating relationships with existing and prospective clients, and identifying opportunities to expand services
* Providing occasional support to wider JLL and NCR Atleos requirements across other global regions (e.g., EMEA and APAC), as needed
* Collaborating with all service lines on account in the delivery of services to include Integrated Facilities Management, Transactions Management, Occupancy Planning, Lease Administration, Center of Excellence and Finance.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in architecture, construction management, business management, finance, or related engineering field

jobs.description:
**Description**

**IS Program Manager - Enterprise Medical Device Strategy - Remote**

The IS Program Manager – Enterprise Medical Device Strategy provides program leadership, strategic coordination, and execution oversight for enterprise initiatives within the Clinical Technology Strategy & Delivery pillar of IS, with a primary focus on enterprise medical device strategy. This role partners closely with senior leadership to translate strategic priorities into actionable programs of work, ensuring initiatives are structured, coordinated, and advanced with clarity, consistency, and measurable impact.

Balancing strategic support with tactical program leadership, the IS Program Manager leads the development and chartering of enterprise programs and initiatives, establishes program frameworks and governance structures, coordinates strategic workstreams, and facilitates cross-functional collaboration. Many initiatives will translate into downstream programs and projects executed by dedicated program management, project management, and implementation teams within CTS&D and across broader IS. While this role does not directly manage those downstream programs or projects, it maintains enterprise-level visibility and oversight to ensure alignment with strategic intent, organizational requirements, established timelines, and intended outcomes. The role also serves as a point of coordination and escalation, helping address cross-program dependencies, resolve barriers, and support execution teams as needed to maintain momentum and successful delivery.

In close partnership with senior leadership, this role helps establish the structure, processes, and organizational alignment necessary to advance enterprise medical device strategy. This includes supporting the development and execution of strategic roadmaps, coordinating enterprise initiatives, analyzing information and performance insights, and ensuring strategic priorities translate into meaningful operational outcomes. Through strong program leadership, organizational awareness, and the ability to influence without direct authority, the IS Program Manager enables leaders to focus on higher-level strategy, stakeholder engagement, and innovation while maintaining alignment, visibility, and accountability across strategic initiatives and their resulting programs of work.

Providence caregivers are not simply valued – they’re invaluable. Join our team at Enterprise Information Services and thrive in our culture of patient-focused, whole-person care built on understanding, commitment, and mutual respect. Your voice matters here, because we know that to inspire and retain the best people, we must empower them.

* Bachelor's Degree in Project Management, Business, Healthcare Administration, Clinical Operations or Information Technology or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 6 years Information Technology and/or Healthcare Industry experience.
* 6 years' experience with Project Management methodology based upon project management principles, including experience implementing and facilitating complex decision-making structures among multiple executive stakeholders with varied interests and priorities.
* 1 year relevant portfolio management experience.
* Demonstrated experience as a speaker in a professional presentation environment, such as conferences and association meetings.
* Experience with vendor/contract management and negotiations.
* Development and execution experience with business development, marketing, communications, financial planning, and benchmarks/metrics in support of improved quality and process design.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Management, Healthcare Administration, or a clinical field
* Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI)
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI)
* Certification in process optimization methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Lean CQIA, or other nationally recognized process improvement certifications
* 8 years of experience in project and/or program management
* 6 years of experience working within the healthcare industry
* Experience developing and establishing enterprise program charters, governance structures, strategic roadmaps, and execution frameworks
* Experience supporting strategic planning, business case development, quantitative and qualitative analysis, and the translation of organizational priorities into actionable programs and initiatives
* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, cross-functional initiatives and providing oversight across multiple workstreams, programs, and project execution teams
* Experience engaging and collaborating with senior leadership, clinical stakeholders, and technical teams within complex, matrixed organizations
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including the ability to understand complex information and develop actionable insights and recommendations for executive audiences

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager, Equitable Electric Mobility
jobs.description:
**About Us**:

CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility. We are a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, it’s been Catalyst Mobility’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. Catalyst Mobility works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. Catalyst Mobility provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

**About The Role**:

As Lead Project Manager, Equitable Electric Mobility, you will help Catalyst Mobility drive equitable zero-emission transportation policies and programs across our priority states. This role will live within Catalyst's Innovative Mobility team, and your primary focus for the upcoming year will be managing operational and program activities within the Towards Equitable Electric Mobility (TEEM) Community of Practice, a collaborative initiative between Catalyst Mobility and The Greenlining Institute.

In this role, you will work with TEEM partners on setting strategic direction in alignment with Catalyst Mobility's broader organizational goals. You will work in close partnership with The Greenlining Institute to deliver hands-on coordination, capacity building, and peer-learning opportunities for a cohort of state-based environmental and equity organizations. You will help execute multi-state project goals, track deliverables, administer program budgets, handle reporting, and oversee efforts to attract additional funding for this work. You will ensure aligned campaign execution across state lines to build support for a national agenda for equitable electric mobility.

**What You'll Do**:

**Program Execution & Management**:

* Co-manage day-to-day TEEM cohort operations and campaign execution in close partnership with The Greenlining Institute.

* Execute clearly defined program workplans, tracking milestones and ensuring accountability across participating TEEM cohort organizations.

* Oversee program budget tracking, contract administration, and re-granting agreements to local environmental justice partners under the guidance of senior leadership with the support of the Legal and Contracts departments.

* Execute program evaluation plans, synthesizing data and collecting metrics to demonstrate program impact and inform ongoing cohort improvements.

* Coordinate cross-functional alignment between TEEM initiatives and external mobility coalitions and campaigns (e.g., Clean RIDES Network, CHARGE, Energize).

**Capacity Building & Facilitation**:

* Facilitate cohort calls, workshops, and working groups (ranging from 5 to 40+ participants) to foster relationship building, shared learning, and tactical collaboration.

* Connect state cohort organizations with relevant technical expertise, policy tools, and resources from within Catalyst Mobility and external networks.

* Assist cohort partners in establishing actionable workplans that strengthen local narrative storytelling and community support for equitable transportation policies.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Program Support**:

* Support relationship management and strategy development with key program funders, coalition leaders, and aligned national campaign partners.

* Contribute to grant proposals, narrative reporting, and funder communications in collaboration with Catalyst Mobility’s development team.

* Represent Catalyst Mobility at designated public events, coalition meetings, and conferences as a subject matter specialist in equitable electric mobility.

* Collaborate with internal teams across Catalyst Mobility, such as the Policy team, to identify operational synergies and shared opportunities.

**What You'll Bring to the Table**:

**Required Qualifications**:

* Experience: 5–7 years of professional experience in social, political, environmental, or policy campaigns with a focus on building partner capacity or coalition management.

* Program Execution: Proven track record of managing complex project timelines, tracking deliverable metrics, and keeping multi-stakeholder initiatives on schedule.

* Equity Centered Skills: Demonstrated commitment to centering belonging, justice, equity, diversity, and inclusion in your work

* Facilitation Skills: Strong group facilitation skills with experience navigating diverse coalition dynamics and building consensus across varied groups.

* Nonprofit Context: At least 2–3 years of experience operating within nonprofit organizational structures and coalition environments.

* Communication: Clear, effective written and verbal communication skills tailored for diverse audiences including community advocates, funders, and peers.

* Travel: Willingness and ability to travel periodically between TEEM target states and nationally as required (approx. 15–20%).

**Desired Qualifications**:

* Subject matter familiarity with electric transportation, clean energy, or mobility policy

* Prior experience supporting nonprofit grant proposals or funder reporting workflows.

* Geographic location within a key TEEM state (Illinois, Michigan, North Carolina, or Virginia).

* Familiarity with project management software, budget tracking tools, and modern collaborative technology stack.

We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn't perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we'd love to hear from you.

We're a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success!

jobs.title: Program Manager II
jobs.description:
Overview:

Goldbelt Professional Services, LLC (GPS) specializes in providing support and expert resources for an extensive range of public health missions, including scientific, technical, and administrative support ranging from junior staff to high-level subject matter experts. We are research- and data-driven, with a team of experts ready to create solutions and customized support tailored to our clients' needs.

**Summary:**

The **Program Manager II** will support the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion (NCCDPHP). The Program Manager will provide project and program management support to help the Office of the Director (OD) organize, prioritize, and manage its responsibilities across the Center, working with divisions as internal customers to identify needs and coordinate support. This role requires a seasoned project management professional with strong organizational and operational judgment who can anticipate when processes or projects need to pivot, respond to high-level organizational requests, and support data- and budget-related decision-making in a dynamic, evolving environment.

This position is based in the Atlanta, GA area. Work may be performed at a CDC facility and/or via telework as determined by contract needs.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Provide project and program management support to the Center's Office of the Director, helping to organize, prioritize, and manage the OD's responsibilities across the Center.
* Work with divisions as internal customers to identify their needs and coordinate appropriate support and solutions.
* Respond to high-level organizational requests and information needs, including locating, compiling, and analyzing information to support timely and accurate responses.
* Develop and implement project management tools, governance structures, and tracking systems to standardize and strengthen program and project delivery.
* Support budget- and resource-related activities and decision-making, including preparing and reviewing supporting documentation and analysis.
* Identify projects, activities, and functions that would benefit from enhanced project management support and recommend approaches to improve them.
* Anticipate and support change management, transition, and process improvement needs, including determining when a process or project should pivot and planning accordingly.
* Develop and update dashboards and other tools to monitor projects, track deadlines, and identify risks.
* Create strategic communications and engage stakeholders to support decision-making as priorities emerge and evolve.
* Support strategic planning and related efforts at the Center and OD level.
* Provide workgroup and meeting support and adapt quickly to shifting organizational priorities and timelines.

Qualifications:

**Necessary Skills and Knowledge:**

* Demonstrated experience managing projects and programs, including planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong organizational and operational skills, with the judgment to anticipate needs, manage change, and determine when processes or projects need to pivot.
* Ability to locate, compile, and analyze information quickly to respond to organizational and leadership requests.
* Ability to develop project management tools, governance structures, tracking systems, and dashboards to monitor performance and identify risks.
* Experience leading change management, transition, and process improvement efforts.
* Familiarity with budget and resource processes and the ability to support budget-related decision-making.
* Strong strategic communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders and support leadership decision-making.
* Ability to identify, prioritize, and respond to emerging priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and project management tools.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* A minimum of 5 years of documented experience working with CDC, federal, or related public health entities; OR a bachelor's degree in health, science, public health administration, policy, or a functionally related field plus at least 2 years of documented experience working with CDC, federal, or related public health entities.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a CDC Public Trust clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Deep familiarity with the CDC, including its organizational structure, operations, and established processes, with the ability to navigate the agency effectively and know where and how to obtain needed information.
* Senior-level experience, typically 10 or more years, in project or program management, preferably supporting a federal public health agency or similar large, complex organization.
* Understanding of the CDC or federal budgeting process and experience supporting budget-related decisions.
* Master's degree in public health, public administration, business administration, or a related field.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience supporting an Office of the Director or other executive/leadership-level function.
* Experience with strategic planning, change management, or organizational transition initiatives in a public health or federal environment.

**Pay and Benefits**

The salary range for this position is $100,000.00-$150,000.00 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings

jobs.description:
Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode!

Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

*Learn more at* *www.veracode.com**, on the* *Veracode blog**, and on* *LinkedIn* *and* *Twitter**.*

**Technical Program Manager, Customer Onboarding**

Veracode is seeking an experienced **Technical Program Manager, Customer Onboarding** to lead the customer onboarding program across Enterprise and Commercial customers.

Reporting to the Vice President of Customer Success, this senior individual contributor will own the **program strategy, governance, and cross-functional execution model** for customer onboarding. The role will provide leadership across multiple concurrent deployments, creating visibility into program health, dependencies, risks, capacity, and customer outcomes while driving accountability across Customer Success, Project Management, Customer Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Product, and customer teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with exceptional program leadership, bringing structure to complex initiatives, anticipating risks, removing systemic blockers, and continuously improving how Veracode delivers customer onboarding at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Program Leadership**: Own the customer onboarding program, establishing clear objectives, priorities, governance, operating rhythms, and measures of success across the deployment portfolio.
* **Portfolio Management**: Maintain a program-level view of active customer deployments, identifying critical dependencies, capacity constraints, systemic risks, and opportunities to improve execution.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership**: Align Project Management, CSEs, SAs, CSMs, Product, and customer stakeholders around priorities, ownership, dependencies, and outcomes. Drive accountability without direct authority.
* **Program Governance** Establish consistent program reviews, stage gates, risk management, escalation paths, decision frameworks, and leadership reporting.

* **Customer & Executive Alignment** Provide clear communication on program health, priorities, risks, and outcomes across customer and Veracode leadership stakeholders.
* **Customer Transition** Ensure a consistent transition from onboarding into ongoing Customer Success, with clear ownership of customer objectives, outcomes, risks, and outstanding priorities.

**Success Metrics**

* Program readiness and execution predictability
* On-time milestone and deployment completion
* Time to go-live and first value
* Visibility and resolution of program risks and dependencies
* Reduction in onboarding delays and escalations
* Consistency of program governance across deployments
* Deployment efficiency and scalability
* Quality of Customer Success transitions

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in **technical program management**, enterprise SaaS implementation, or complex customer-facing technology programs.
* Demonstrated success leading **multi-workstream programs involving multiple teams, stakeholders, and technical dependencies**.
* Strong experience with **program governance, portfolio management, risk and dependency management, operating cadences, KPIs, and executive reporting**.
* Proven ability to translate strategic objectives into structured programs and measurable outcomes.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS implementations and customer onboarding.
* Working knowledge of SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, enterprise integrations, and cloud software environments.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence teams and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Experience with Jira, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent program management platforms.
* Experience with application security, SAST, SCA, DAST, or DevSecOps environments is a plus.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Federal
jobs.description:
**Hypori, Inc.** is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform enables users to access enterprise apps and data from any mobile device—with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. Learn more at hypori.com.

**Overview**

Hypori is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform gives users access to enterprise apps and data from any mobile device, with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, we are expanding into new commercial and regulated markets.

Hypori is looking for a strategic, delivery-focused Program Manager, Federal Programs to join our Customer Success team. You will own a portfolio of Hypori's most important Department of War customer relationships, directing critical system implementations and serving as the primary point of contact for delivery and technical stakeholders from implementation through adoption, while the Strategic Account Director manages the commercial and executive relationship. You will report to the Senior Director of Customer Operations and Delivery.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role. Your work directly determines whether Hypori's largest and most consequential deployments succeed and become operationalized inside the customer environment. Our technology is real and differentiated, solving a problem that legacy MDM and container approaches have not, and more than 95,000 Department of War users are on the platform today. You will be the customer's voice inside Hypori, shaping the Hypori experience from inside the program, with direct partnership across executive leadership.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct the definition, planning, execution, and monitoring of a portfolio of strategic programs and projects across the Department of War
* Provide weekly, and sometimes daily, program and project management throughout the program lifecycle, monitoring progress against milestones
* Align Federal Programs personnel across customer engagements and internal projects
* Identify and manage program risks and issues, and define corrective actions to avoid or minimize disruption to implementation
* Design program playbooks that standardize repeatable implementation processes across similar customers
* Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery and technical stakeholders implementing Hypori in complex government environments
* Engage internal and external stakeholders on programmatic and technical topics, including product capabilities, implementation requirements (RMF, network, authentication), and enterprise-wide rollouts to end users
* Develop Statements of Work, government proposals, and procurement documents, including implementation scope, deployment requirements, and technical specifications, in support of opportunities led by the Strategic Account Director
* Monitor product adoption and usage health across the portfolio, and proactively engage internal teams and customers to course-correct accounts at risk of low adoption or non-renewal
* Build and run the monthly and quarterly rhythm of business for federal customers, including performance impact reviews, strategy sessions, and status reviews
* Establish delivery metrics and build reports and dashboards that show customer success, project execution, program health, and progress against KPIs
* Partner with Marketing and customer representatives on communications that support deployment milestones, feature adoption, and program status
* Represent Hypori's product and customer implementations at trade shows, conferences, and working groups

**Qualifications**

* 8–10 years of Department of War program management experience across complex, multi-program enterprise organizations, including managing dependencies across a large portfolio of strategic customers
* Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification (required)
* Active Department of War Secret clearance (Tier 3 investigation), with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance (Tier 5 investigation)

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. jobs.description:
**Who we are**

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

**What we need**

Symbotic is seeking for an ICS Implementation Project Manager to join our Industrial Controls Program Management team within our Industrial Controls organization. Your job will be to schedule, scope, and plan PLC update activities, coordinate closely with live site operations teams, and facilitate a robust Jira-driven triage and intake process.

**What we do**

The Industrial Controls Program Management team is part of the Industrial Controls organization, which is responsible for developing, deploying, and supporting controls products, software, and systems for Symbotic’s automated warehouse solutions. The team focuses on scoping, scheduling, and orchestrating controls release activities and live-site issue triage so our rapidly scaling fleet of customer sites remains stable, predictable, and high-performing.

**What you'll do**

* Own the end-to-end planning, scheduling, and execution roadmap for industrial controls (PLC) updates, hotfixes, and sustaining releases across live operational sites.
* Facilitate the triage and intake process for live-site issues, enhancement requests, and field escalations, ensuring proper backlog hygiene, technical scoping, prioritization, and SLA tracking in Jira.
* Act as the primary cross-functional liaison with Site Operations leads and cross-functional partners to negotiate maintenance windows, rollout schedules, and pre- and post-update verification procedures.
* Enforce rigorous Management of Change protocols, rollback strategies, and operational gating criteria to minimize unplanned operational downtime during controls deployments.
* Establish repeatable planning and release cadences that minimize site disruption and support smooth, predictable rollouts.
* Standardize rollout runbooks, build visibility dashboards, and refine post-release retrospectives to continuously streamline fleetwide controls deployments.
* Coordinate across Controls Engineering, Software Release, software quality assurance, and Site Operations to turn operational requests, maintenance items, and bug fixes into structured, risk-mitigated release windows.

**What you'll need**

* Minimum of 5 years of related experience or equivalent work experience.
* Experience in project engineering, release coordination, or project management within industrial automation, robotics, warehouse automation, or complex electromechanical systems.
* Advanced proficiency in Jira and Confluence for intake workflows, triage facilitation, sprint and release tracking, and cross-functional reporting.
* Proven experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder release schedules, site maintenance windows, and structured change management protocols.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a demonstrated ability to align engineering, software quality assurance, and 24/7 site operations teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, such as Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, Systems, or Computer Science, or equivalent practical technical experience.
* Practical experience or familiarity with industrial PLC platforms, including Rockwell Automation Studio 5000, controls commissioning, systems integration, Agile methodologies, or formal project management frameworks is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Information Assurance Analyst / Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC**

At Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC, we deliver secure, innovative solutions in support of national defense and intelligence missions. As a trusted government contracting partner, we provide top-tier intelligence and technology services that safeguard our nation. Our team is mission-driven, and we are committed to building careers that matter.

**Location:** This is a US-based remote position, with occasional on-site visits to Arlington, VA as required (travel at employee's expense).

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Security Clearance:** No security clearance required. Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation required prior to start; ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

**Job Summary**
---------------

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking a Senior Information Assurance (IA) Analyst / Program Manager to support the Headquarters, Department of the Army G-1, Directorate of Prevention, Resilience, and Readiness (DPRR) Information Assurance Support Services (IASS) program. This key personnel role leads the Information Assurance program for the Drug and Alcohol Management Information System (DAMIS), the Risk Reduction Unit Risk Inventory Application, and associated standalone applications hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud. Serving as the Information Assurance Security Officer (IASO) and the Contracting Officer Representative's (COR) main point of contact, this position owns Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance, continuous monitoring, and Authority to Operate (ATO) maintenance and reauthorization, and supervises the IA Analyst. Core hours are 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the overall Information Assurance program for DAMIS under the direction of the System Owner/COR and the Program Information Systems Security Manager (P-ISSM), serving as IASO and the COR's main point of contact.
* Manage the system's Risk Management Framework (RMF) process; prepare, coordinate, and submit security documentation for review and routing to the approving authority, and adapt to changing requirements from TBAI, Army CIO, or DoW.
* Use the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS) to obtain and maintain the system ATO; perform weekly continuous monitoring of ATO requirements, STIGs, and Control Correlation Identifiers (CCIs) and report weekly ATO status with a remediation plan.
* Develop and maintain the RMF modernization and timeline plan with ATO milestones, and prepare and submit the ATO reauthorization package in eMASS before the current ATO expires.
* Manage the vulnerability compliance report and lead annual contingency, security, and recovery tests, submitting documentation within 2 business days of test completion.
* Prepare FISMA-compliant reports and update information assurance data in the Army Portfolio Management System (APMS), Army Asset & Vulnerability Tracking Resource (A&VTR), and eMASS.
* Prepare and submit the Monthly Status Report (MSR) on RMF compliance, challenges, issues, and prior-month activity.
* Serve as a member of the agency's Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT), acknowledging incidents within 15 minutes and initiating approved mitigation within one hour during duty hours; maintain the Emergency Operations Plan.
* Review system change requests and recommend implementation or alternatives based on IA vulnerabilities within 2 business days.
* Attend IA working groups, conferences, and recurring meetings virtually or in person, and provide minutes and recommendations within 2 business days.
* Supervise the IA Analyst, review deliverables for quality, and provide backup coverage for IA Analyst tasks.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field.
* At least 6 years of technical and compliance experience maintaining a system's security posture and managing security within a Microsoft Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environment.
* At least 2 years of experience leading teams.
* Proven IA/cybersecurity experience managing the security posture of systems involving .NET, Windows, Azure, Oracle, and Red Hat.
* Strong background in data architecture, the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and Red Hat and Windows security and administration.
* Extensive experience implementing and auditing against DISA Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists to oversee RMF processes and continuous monitoring.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain a system's ATO and obtain a new ATO.
* Experience using eMASS.
* Strong technical writing, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical staff, program leadership, and Government stakeholders.
* Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation prior to start.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with ACAS, SCAP Compliance Checker, and DISA STIG Viewer.
* Experience supporting systems through RMF changes such as the transition from NIST SP 800-53 Revision 4 to Revision 5.
* Experience supporting Army systems hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud.
* Experience with systems handling Privacy Act, PII, or HIPAA-protected data.
* Experience with FISMA reporting in APMS and A&VTR.

**Certifications**
------------------

* Active Tier 3 (NACI) or higher background investigation prior to start.
* DoD 8570 IAM Level II certification (e.g., CISSP, CGRC/CAP, CISM, GSLC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment.
* DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment. CISSP satisfies both IAM Level II and IAT Level II.

jobs.description:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world's most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

### **Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst,** **Advanced Cybercrime and Engagements Team, Insikt Group, Recorded Future**

**Location:** Remote USA (Preference for Boston, MA or Washington, DC)

**The Role:** You will research and analyze criminal activity on dark web/underground platforms, such as forums, shops, marketplaces, and secure communication channels, to identify cybercrime trends and threat actors. You will also help identify sources, maintain persistence on those sources, and interact with threat actors to obtain information not publicly available. You will be engaged in proactive research, with the flexibility to respond to requests from Recorded Future colleagues and customers related to cybercriminal activities. You will use open-source intelligence (OSINT), internal tools such as the Recorded Future Intelligence Operations Platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) to inform customers and internal stakeholders about the latest cybercriminal threat activities and trends, ensuring timely, actionable insights.

**Who You'll Work With:** The Advanced Cybercrime and Engagement team is a group of subject matter experts specializing in identifying, tracking, and mitigating cybercriminal threat actors and their activities. The team supports a variety of Recorded Future products, teams, services, and initiatives for both internal stakeholders and customers. You will also cross-collaborate with other Insikt Group teams on research projects and some customer requests.

**What You'll Do:**

* Research, track, and author finished intelligence reports on cybercriminal threat actors, malicious tools and services, source types, Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), campaigns, and other cybercriminal-related topics.
* Identify, propose, and publish proactive Analyst Notes and reports on new and emerging threats, cybercriminal activities, and campaigns, specifically on dark web threat actors, money laundering operations, hacktivists, and threat groups associated with different types of cybercriminality for customer and public consumption.
* Drive sourcing, collecting, and curating new data into the Recorded Future Intelligence Cloud, using AI-assisted triage to cut through volume faster than manual review.
* Create and maintain access to underground sources and personas to achieve net-new intelligence.
* Contribute ideas for new automations or AI-assisted workflows to improve the speed and consistency of the team's production process, and share lessons learned/best practices broadly.

**What You'll Bring (Required Qualifications):**

* Fluency or professional proficiency in Russian
* Strong knowledge and experience with analytic tradecraft, the intelligence cycle, open-source intelligence gathering techniques, and strong intelligence writing skills, techniques, and methodologies.
* Be able to document and cogently explain to customers research findings. Be comfortable and confident in presenting research findings to customers and at conferences.
* 3+ years of professional experience in roles in cyber intelligence, cybersecurity more broadly, cyber and cybercriminal investigations, or other related disciplines.
* Advanced knowledge of operational security (OPSEC) procedure and practices.
* Demonstrated experience operating on dark web sources (forums, marketplaces, and shops) and mediums of communication.
* Experience in engaging with cybercriminals and participating in covert operations in handling sensitive information.
* Knowledge of the structure and trends within the cybercriminal economy and landscape in different/specific regions: common communications vectors, source locations, operational security considerations, and more.
* Experience with handling, transacting in, and tracing cryptocurrencies.
* Knowledge of and ability to conduct blockchain and cryptocurrency investigations.
* Knowledge of money laundering, fraud, and current cybercrime TTPs.
* Ability to work collaboratively with others in a globally distributed environment.
* Regular, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your own research and writing, and the instinct to reach for them to speed up or automate a task.
* Ability to write clear, specific AI prompts and iterate as needed, and to fact-check and edit AI output for validity and objectivity.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BA/BS or MA/MS degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, International Relations, Security Studies, Regional Studies, Criminology, or a related discipline.
* Knowledge and understanding of the cybercriminal ecosystem.
* Knowledge and understanding of the links and relationships between cybercriminal, hacktivist, extremist, and state-sponsored operations and organizations.
* Technical knowledge of malware trends, including ransomware, its functionality and capabilities, and how it's impacting entities.
* Practical experience integrating or leveraging LLMs (for example, GPT, Claude, Gemini) in real-world applications, tools, or workflows to develop efficiencies in intelligence analysis.

**Overview**

Hypori is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform gives users access to enterprise apps and data from any mobile device, with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, we are expanding into new commercial and regulated markets.

You will report to the Senior Director of Customer Operations and Delivery.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role. Your work directly determines whether Hypori's largest and most consequential deployments succeed and become operationalized inside the customer environment. Our technology is real and differentiated, solving a problem that legacy MDM and container approaches have not, and more than 95,000 Department of War users are on the platform today. jobs.title: Data Analyst, Risk Adjustment
jobs.description:
Risk Adjustment Data Analyst
  
Position Summary
  
The Risk Adjustment Data Analyst supports end to end risk adjustment and revenue cycle operations by analyzing HCC submissions by ArchWell Health and any rejections at Clearninghouse/payer/CMS level, managing chart retrieval and review workflows, and ensuring accurate ingestion of care gap and clinical documentation data for various sources. This role is critical to maintaining RAF accuracy, reducing submission errors, and enabling continuous monthly reconciliation across MA programs. The role requires flexibility to perform additional tasks as needed, especially as risk adjustment and quality requirements evolve across markets and programs.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
HCC Reconciliation & Submission Validation
  

* Perform monthly validation of all HCC submissions (MAO004, encounters, claims, sweeps).
* Analyze payer acceptance, rejections, and 277CA/999 acknowledgement files.
* Identify new, recaptured, and dismissed HCCs and reconcile against internal systems (VIM, HCC engine).
* Present and route any rejections/gaps for appropriate teams.

Sweeps & Payer Data Management
  

* Review sweeps datasets to ensure completeness, accuracy, and payer acceptance.
* Support ASM workflows and monitor acceptance/rejection trends.
* Track payer healthcare gaps and validate alignment with internal care gap logic.

Chart Retrieval & Review Support
  

* Build and maintain chart retrieval/review prioritization rules (1LR, 2LR, external providers).
* Monitor chart retrieval programs, turnaround times, and vendor performance.
* ROI analysis of various programs
* Manage unlinked charts and ensure proper linkage to members, service dates, and HCCs.

Care Gap & Clinical Data Ingestion
  

* Support ingestion/analysis health plan care gap files and ensure accurate mapping into VIM and analyze suspects conversion rate from various sources.
* Validate care gap completeness and partner with clinical teams to ensure data is actionable.
* Develop or refine member stratification logic for outreach and in home visit prioritization.

Reporting & Analytics
  

* Build/Maintain dashboards and reports to track HCC operations work inclusive of reconciliation, chart retrieval progress, and rejection trends.
* Provide insights to leadership on productivity, throughput, and operational bottlenecks at market/center/payer level.
* Support continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and recommending process enhancements.

Cross Functional Collaboration
  

* Work closely with Operations, RCM, Coding, Clinical Documentation, Vendor partners, and IT/Data teams.
* Participate in governance meetings to review trends, exceptions, and payer specific issues.
* Ensure alignment across teams to reduce sweeps level escalations and maintain steady state workflows.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, Public Health, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in risk adjustment, RCM, healthcare analytics, or payer operations.
* Strong understanding of HCCs models, RAF, MAO004, 277CA/999/835 files, and encounter submission workflows.
* Deep experience with SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).
* Ability to interpret clinical documentation and coding outputs (ICD 10, HCC mapping).
* Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills.
* Experience working with chart retrieval vendors or clinical documentation teams preferred.

Competencies
  

* Detail oriented with strong data validation skills
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines
* Strong cross functional collaboration
* Comfort working in fast paced, evolving operational environments
* Commitment to accuracy, compliance, and documentation integrity

Overview:

Goldbelt Professional Services, LLC (GPS) specializes in providing support and expert resources for an extensive range of public health missions, including scientific, technical, and administrative support ranging from junior staff to high-level subject matter experts. We are research- and data-driven, with a team of experts ready to create solutions and customized support tailored to our clients' needs.

The **Program Analyst III** will support the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Injury Prevention and Control (NCIPC), Division of Overdose Prevention (DOP), providing administrative, logistical, and program operations support in connection with emerging priorities and project management for the program. The Program Analyst will support day-to-day administrative operations, travel and conference coordination, personnel and timekeeping processes, meeting logistics, and program documentation and tracking, working closely with program leadership and the administrative team. *Program Documentation, Tracking, and Stakeholder Support*

* Security and Clearance Requests: Process internal and security clearance requests in accordance with federal guidelines and CDC operating systems.

* Ability to compile and analyze information to respond to tracking, reporting, and data reques

The Strategy & Executive Office (SEO) organization is responsible for setting the short, mid, and long-term strategy for Novo Nordisk, Inc and ensures flawless execution of our key priorities. You will manage parts of the enterprise level strategy, ensuring together with your leaders that strategic ambition, priorities and enablers are connected and translated throughout the organization. In this role you will support defining USO's future direction, use scenario planning and stress testing to evaluate alternatives and surface trade-offs to help senior leaders make the hard choices that secure a sustainable, high impact future. You will convert strategic priorities into actionable initiatives with clear owners, timelines and success metrics, embed change management to drive adoption and partner with Finance to align investments and track benefits. Acting as the bridge across commercial, medical, access, supply and operations, you will ensure all parts of the value chain come together under one cohesive strategy, working closely with the Director, US Operations Strategy, to integrate strategic shifts into our strategy management processes.

  

**Relationships**

Reports to Director, US Operations Strategy. * Ecosystem insight and risk assessment: monitor the healthcare ecosystem (regulatory, technology, market, competitor) and translate external trends into strategic implications; identify and assess enterprise risks and recommend mitigations

* Communication and strategic reporting: develop audience appropriate strategy communications and presentation materials for executive and management audiences; partner with Executive Communications as needed
* Team dynamics: foster a collaborative, accountable culture; coach and mentor colleagues; ensure close partnership with the Director, US Operations Strategy to integrate strategic shifts into the broader strategy management process
  

**Physical Requirements**

10-20% overnight travel required.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university or equivalent education with 7+ years of experience in progressively relevant corporate business strategy development and planning, marketing and brand management, consulting, commercial operations experience required; pharmaceutical or CPG industries strongly preferred
* Master's Degree/MBA from an accredited university or equivalent education with 5+ years of experience and/or Doctorate degree from an accredited university or equivalent education with 3+ years of experience

**Job Overview**

As a Business Analyst (Digital Channels), you’ll connect business needs with digital solutions. Digital Business Analyst

**Location:** United States  
**Department:** Digital Strategy  
**Reports to:** Digital Platform Owner  
**Employment type:** Full-time / Contract

About the role

We’re looking for a Digital Business Analyst to help turn customer and business needs into measurable digital outcomes.

You’ll work across product, technology, design, data, operations, and business teams to identify opportunities, define priorities, and deliver improvements to our digital platforms. This role goes beyond documenting requirements: you’ll help ensure that what we build solves the right problem, improves the user experience, and delivers meaningful value.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with a practical understanding of digital products, customer journeys, agile delivery, and performance measurement.

Key responsibilities

Define digital opportunities

* Partner with stakeholders to understand customer, colleague, and business needs.
* Analyze user behavior, feedback, operational data, and market trends to identify opportunities.
* Translate complex problems into clear, outcome-focused goals.
* Support prioritization based on customer value, business impact, risk, effort, and strategic alignment.

Shape products and experiences

* Map current and future-state customer journeys, processes, and service experiences.
* Identify friction, duplication, failure points, and opportunities for simplification.
* Develop clear business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and supporting documentation.
* Work with product managers, technology teams and subject matter experts to evaluate solution options.
* Ensure requirements remain focused on the intended outcome rather than simply reproducing existing processes.
* Support accessibility, usability, security, resilience, data, and compliance considerations throughout delivery.

Enable effective delivery

* Participate in discovery, planning, refinement, sprint reviews, **testing**, and retrospectives.
* Clarify requirements and resolve questions quickly during delivery.
* Help teams make informed trade-offs when scope, time, cost, or technical constraints change.
* Coordinate dependencies across platforms, products, and business areas.
* Support user acceptance testing, release readiness, and post-launch validation.
* Maintain traceability between needs, requirements, delivered capabilities, and expected outcomes.

Measure and improve results

* Define key performance indicators and outcome measures with product and business stakeholders.
* Establish baseline measures and support benefits tracking after launch.
* Analyze whether changes improve customer experience, adoption, conversion, efficiency, quality, or other agreed objectives.
* Use data and feedback to recommend iteration and continuous improvement.
* Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you’ll bring

Required experience and skills

* Experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Digital Analyst, Product Owner, or similar role in a digital environment.
* Experience working on customer-facing websites, mobile applications, digital platforms, or internal digital products.
* Strong understanding of digital product delivery and agile ways of working.
* Ability to translate business and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements.
* Experience with customer journey mapping, process analysis, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use qualitative and quantitative information.
* Experience defining or tracking product metrics, KPIs, or business outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, and drive decisions to closure.
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader customer and business objective.

Preferred experience

* Experience in financial services, banking, payments, insurance, or another regulated industry.
* Familiarity with digital analytics tools, dashboards, experimentation, or customer feedback platforms.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, data flows, or platform capabilities.
* Understanding of accessibility, privacy, security, risk, and regulatory considerations.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed organization with distributed teams.
* Relevant business analysis, agile, product, or process-improvement certification.

What success looks like

Within the first 6–12 months, you will:

* Help teams define clearer outcomes before work enters delivery.
* Improve the quality and consistency of requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Surface customer and operational pain points that lead to actionable improvements.
* Strengthen alignment among business, product, design, technology, and control teams.
* Support the delivery of digital changes that can be measured after launch.
* Help reduce avoidable rework by identifying dependencies, risks, and unanswered questions earlier.

Working style

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

* Start with the customer or user problem, not the preferred solution.
* Focus conversations on outcomes, evidence, and trade-offs.
* Bring structure to ambiguity without creating unnecessary process.
* Collaborate openly and value different perspectives.
* Take ownership of decisions, follow-through, and measurable results.
* Communicate with clarity and adapt your style for different audiences.
* Balance pace with responsible delivery in a regulated environment.

Pay: $110,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The Cybersecurity Analyst is a mid-level, hands-on role within Star Group's IT Security team, reporting to the Cybersecurity Engineer. This position is responsible for day-to-day security operations, monitoring, incident response support, vulnerability management, and compliance evidence collection across Star Group's corporate and field environments. The Cybersecurity Analyst works closely with the IT Security Team to maintain and mature the organization's security posture, and serves as a key operational responder for security alerts, tickets, and audit requests.

This role is well suited to a candidate with 3–5 years of hands-on security operations experience who is looking to deepen expertise across endpoint protection, network access control, secure email gateway, application allowlisting, privileged access management, SIEM/SOAR, and vulnerability management in a lean, high-ownership team environment. The role also offers the opportunity to gain exposure to the strategic development of security policies, the implementation of IT security technologies, and work with cross-functional teams to deliver targeted security solutions.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
=========================================

**Security Monitoring & Incident Response**
-------------------------------------------

* Monitor security alerts and events generated by EDR, NAC, SIEM/SOAR, ZTA, email security, and DLP platforms; triage, investigate, and escalate per documented incident response playbooks.
* Perform first-line analysis of phishing reports, malware alerts, and suspicious activity; contain and remediate confirmed incidents in coordination with the IT Security Team.
* Support tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews; contribute to after-action reports and lessons-learned documentation.
* Maintain and tune detection rules, alert thresholds, and correlation logic to reduce false positives and improve mean-time-to-detect/respond.
* Perform after-hours security event containment and remediation activities as needed.

**Vulnerability & Patch Management**
------------------------------------

* Run and review recurring vulnerability scans across servers, endpoints, and network infrastructure; validate and prioritize findings by exploitability and business risk.
* Track remediation of vulnerabilities against SLA targets, including expedited handling of CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV).
* Coordinate with broader IT teams on patch deployment cycles for servers, workstations, endpoint devices, and SaaS solutions; verify patch compliance reporting.
* Maintain the vulnerability management dashboard and produce recurring metrics for leadership and audit purposes.

**Identity, Access & Endpoint Security**
----------------------------------------

* Assist in administering day-to-day operations of Privileged Access Management (PAM) tooling, including onboarding/offboarding privileged accounts, session review, and access certification support.
* Support Network Access Control (NAC) operations, including device onboarding, policy exceptions, and unauthorized-device investigation across 100+ sites.
* Assist with administering endpoint application control / allowlisting policy requests, exception handling, and false-positive tuning.
* Support quarterly and annual user access reviews (UAR) for in-scope systems.

**Governance, Risk & Compliance Support**
-----------------------------------------

* Collect, organize, and validate audit evidence in support of audit requirements, industry assessments and cybersecurity disclosure requirements.
* Track and report on security awareness training completion, phishing simulation results, and related compliance metrics.

**Documentation & Process Improvement**
---------------------------------------

* Maintain accurate, current documentation for security tools, configurations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of playbooks, runbooks, and automation to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Assist in the evaluation and testing of new security tools and integrations under the direction of the Security Engineer and Director, IT Security.
* Support the maintenance and reporting functions of the team's internal security program dashboard, including data quality of tracked metrics.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and/or work experience.
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in security operations, IT infrastructure/security, or a related technical role.
* Demonstrated experience with at least two of the following: EDR/antivirus platforms, SIEM/SOAR, network access control, privileged access management, vulnerability scanning tools, application allowlisting technology, or email security gateways.
* Experience supporting or participating in a compliance program for a publicly traded company is strongly preferred.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation and ability to meet the company's motor vehicle policy.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Working knowledge of core security domains: endpoint protection, network security, identity and access management, and vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with Windows Server and Windows endpoint administration; working knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID.
* Basic to intermediate scripting ability (PowerShell, Python, or similar) for automation, reporting, or log analysis.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, VPN) sufficient to investigate, troubleshoot, and adjudicate security events.
* Familiarity with common security frameworks (NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, ISO 27000, Secure Controls Framework) is a plus.

**Certifications**
--------

As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

**Program Analyst – Program Reporting, Radar System Replacement (RSR)**
=======================================================================

**Work Location:** Herndon, VA

**Shape the Future of Air Traffic Management with Peraton**
-----------------------------------------------------------

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton delivers the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe, connected, and moving forward.

  

We’re seeking innovative, mission-driven professionals who thrive in complex, high-impact environments and want to help shape the future of air traffic management. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on one of the world’s most critical transportation infrastructures while collaborating with experts across aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

  

**At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission—you’ll help define it.**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Peraton is seeking a **Program Analyst** to lead program reporting efforts for the FAA’s Radar System Replacement (RSR) team within the BNATCS program. This role is responsible for consolidating information from site teams, regional managers, vendors, schedulers, and functional leads into accurate, actionable reports that support program execution and leadership decision-making. This role will be supporting our team on-site at our Herndon, VA office.

  

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and analytical thinker who can turn complex program information into clear executive briefings, dashboards, status reports, and action trackers. This individual will help maintain reporting standards, identify emerging issues, resolve conflicting information, and provide leadership with timely insight into program progress, risks, accomplishments, and critical decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Lead Program Reporting:** Establish and maintain reporting schedules, templates, submission requirements, and review processes for daily, weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting.
* **Consolidate Program Status:** Collect and validate updates on site readiness, surveys, equipment deliveries, installation, testing, training, and return-to-service activities.
* **Develop Leadership Briefings:** Prepare executive summaries, dashboards, presentations, and Program Management Review materials for Peraton leadership and FAA stakeholders.
* **Support Program Coordination:** Develop concise updates for FAA, Peraton, and vendor meetings, highlighting accomplishments, outstanding issues, critical blockers, action owners, and required decisions.
* **Align Reporting with Program Schedules:** Coordinate with scheduling teams to ensure reported milestones, forecasts, delays, and recovery plans align with the Integrated Master Schedule and applicable FAA Corporate Work Plan information.
* **Manage Actions and Decisions:** Maintain action, issue, and decision logs; track ownership and due dates; and proactively follow up to ensure timely resolution.
* **Monitor Program Risks:** Work with risk management and functional leads to communicate potential impacts involving equipment deliveries, installation, staffing, logistics, training, and technical activities.
* **Analyze Program Performance:** Track planned versus actual progress, milestone completion, installation throughput, and staffing readiness. Identify trends, potential delays, and areas requiring management attention.
* **Ensure Reporting Accuracy:** Reconcile conflicting information, validate source data, maintain consistent reporting standards, and clearly distinguish confirmed updates from estimates and pending decisions.
* **Coordinate Vendor Reporting:** Monitor vendor reporting requirements, identify missing or inconsistent submissions, and elevate unresolved issues to program leadership.
* **Improve Field Communications:** Develop site updates, newsletters, and lessons-learned summaries to strengthen communication across geographically dispersed teams.
* **Maintain Program Documentation:** Organize reports, briefing materials, source data, and supporting records in designated program repositories while maintaining version control and information-handling standards.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

* Deliver accurate, consistent, and timely reporting across all program levels.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility into site progress, schedule performance, emerging risks, and decisions requiring attention.
* Maintain accountability through clearly defined action owners, deadlines, and timely issue escalation.
* Identify performance trends and potential delays early enough to support proactive corrective action.
* Establish consistent reporting practices that improve communication, data quality, and coordination across field teams and functional organizations.

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* U.S. Citizen
