jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

The **Business Operations Manager** is a hands-on business partner who helps delivery leaders manage the operational health of government and commercial services programs. The role connects program data to business decisions by monitoring revenue, margin, forecasts, delivery milestones, and risk. This position works closely with delivery, sales, finance, accounting, contracts, HR, procurement, and operations teams and supports executive and delivery leaders across national security, federal, and commercial portfolios.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Own project controls oversight, to include recurring analysis and reporting for program and portfolio performance, including revenue, cost, margin, backlog, forecasts, staffing, utilization, and other key performance indicators.
* Monitor project execution against financial plans, delivery schedules, customer commitments, contractual requirements, and internal targets to help ensure programs remain on time, on margin, and positioned to achieve revenue objectives.
* Identify performance variances, emerging risks, and unfavorable trends by determining business drivers behind the numbers, assessing potential impact, and recommending corrective actions or escalation paths.
* Partner directly with the Chief Delivery Officer and Managing Directors supporting national security, federal, and commercial delivery portfolios.
* Challenge assumptions and communicate directly with delivery and business leaders when results and execution plans are off track by presenting an assessment, standing behind the analysis, and helping leaders translate recommendations into action.
* Serve as the bridge between financial data and operational execution by converting complex program metrics into clear business implications for leaders.
* Prepare and maintain executive-ready dashboards, reports, scorecards, and presentation materials for quarterly business reviews, operational reviews, customer discussions, and larger organizational meetings.
* Brief leaders and broader audiences on performance metrics, risks, trends, and recommendations. Respond confidently to questions and explain or defend the underlying conclusions.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounting on project financials, forecasting, budget performance, margin analysis, and data integrity; reconcile discrepancies and ensure reporting is timely and accurate.
* Partner with Program Managers, Delivery Managers, Sales, Contracts, HR, and Procurement to support operational planning, resource needs, staffing changes, onboarding, timekeeping compliance, purchasing activities, and other program requirements.
* Support contract and program governance by tracking deliverables, reporting deadlines, compliance requirements, action items, and required documentation across government and commercial engagements.
* Build and improve repeatable operating processes, reporting tools, templates, and controls that increase visibility, consistency, and accountability across the delivery organization.
Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy, organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or related fields.
* Eight to 10 years of experience in business operations, delivery operations, program or project management, sales, or finance within a government contracting environment in support of mid-large sized government contractors or complexed, matrixed federal services organizations.
* Strong understanding of project and program financials, including revenue, cost, margin, forecasting, and budget performance.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify risks, assess business impact, and develop well-supported recommendations.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft OS and experience preparing accurate financial or operational reports, dashboards, and executive-level presentation materials.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain numbers in clear business terms and tailor communication for delivery leaders, executives, and cross-functional partners.
* Confidence and professional judgment to raise concerns, navigate difficult conversations, respectfully challenge leaders, and maintain an objective point of view when recommendations are questioned.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet recurring reporting deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently in an individual contributor role while building productive relationships across Finance, Accounting, Sales, Delivery, Contracts, HR, Procurement, and Operations.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS requirements and common government contracting program controls or financial processes.
* Experience with enterprise financial systems, project accounting tools, data visualization platforms, project management tools, and/or business intelligence reporting.
Experience supporting quarterly business reviews, operating reviews, portfolio reviews, or similar executive performance discussions.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems (NGMS) is looking for a **Senior Principal Change Management Project Manager** to support the **Manufacturing Strategy & Integration (MS&I)** organization as Organizational Change Management Lead.There are severalmulti‑year, sector and enterprise‑wide transformation initiatives across MS&I that require strong organizational change management plans and implementation to be successful. The focus of these projects varies from early collaboration, to training to cycle time reduction.

This is a **hybrid position** that can be based in Salt Lake City, Rolling Meadows, Baltimore, San Diego, or Sunnyvale. The selected candidate must be within commuting distance of one of these sites to meet in-office requirements.

**Position Summary / Responsibilities:**

This role will serve as the primary change management authority for the MS&I organization, reporting to the MS&I director, in partnership with Mission Systems Talent & Org Effectiveness (Prosci‑aligned) to embed structured change practices across multiple projects.

**What You Will Get To Do:**

* **Deployment / Change Management Project Management –** Lead planning, coordination and execution of deployment and change management activities. Includes resource planning for human resources needed for execution (communications, learning/development, vendors, etc.). Must balance both the high-level strategic plan and the detailed execution to enable people-centric ROI of the project from start to finish.
* **Define & Execute Change Strategy** – In partnership with MS Organization Effectiveness & Talent, build the end‑to‑end change roadmaps (ADKAR‑based), aligning with enterprise architecture and business objectives.
* **Strategic Planning & Road Mapping -** Consolidate individual project change road maps into a single, phased program roadmap that highlights inter dependencies, key milestones, and critical go live dates.
* **Stakeholder Analysis –** Lead project teams to identify impacted and interested stakeholders. Maintain a master stakeholder register with impact scores, key analyses of impact of processes, roles, etc. and engagement strategies including resistance strategies.
* **Integrated Communication Management –** In partnership with Communication SMEs, develop a cohesive communications strategy and communications plan, overseeing creation of multi-channel deliverables.
* **Training & Enablement Architecture –** Define the training model to scale across projects in partnership with Learning / Development / Talent SMEs. Develop training roadmap and plans. Ensure development of near-term training deliverables and actions according to the strategy while working with functions on long-term strategy of training & PrOP into day-to-day operations.
* **Leadership Management –** In partnership with cross functional leaders, develop sponsorship and stakeholder strategies to ensure leadership engagement and buy-in throughout the initiative. Create middle and frontline leadership strategies as part of larger change management plans, ensure timely execution.

**The Selected Candidate will:**

* Possess superior organization and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels
* Have the ability to obtain Prosci certification within 90 days of employment, with the certification sponsored by Northrop Grumman

**Basic Qualifications for the Sr. Principal Change Management Project Manager:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience leading redeployment and change management; OR a Master’s degree and 6 or more years of relevant work experience leading redeployment and change management.
* Project management experience
* Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Secret clearance
* U.S. citizenship

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* PMP certification
* Prosci certification
* Technical change‑management experience embedded within Agile/SAFe software development lifecycles.
* Experience in multiple functions or programs within aerospace industry

**What We Can Offer You:**

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a work environment which encourages your growth and supports the mutual success of our people and our company. Northrop Grumman benefits give you the flexibility and control to choose the benefits that make the most sense for you and your family.

Your benefits will include the following: Health Plan, Savings Plan, Paid Time Off and Additional Benefits including Education Assistance, Training and Development, 9/80 Work Schedule (where available), and much more!

Description Principal Data Analyst

**Principal Data Analyst**

  
  

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

  
  

About the Team

  
  

The Bank Tech Analytics team is a group dedicated to advancing data-driven decision-making and operational excellence across the enterprise, delivering comprehensive services for Bank Tech while actively contributing back to the broader organization. The team provides core capabilities spanning metrics and insights frameworks, applied analytics, operational efficiency automation, and AI integration. Through continuous stakeholder partnerships and automated data pipelines via Snowflake/Onelake and Databricks, Bank Tech Analytics transforms complex information into actionable insights and custom reporting solutions. This work enhances the developer experience, equips leaders to drive strategy, and delivers high-impact value by fostering enterprise-wide collaboration and pioneering innovative analytics transformations.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

* Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

**Data Management**

* At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
* At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

* Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

jobs.title: Principal Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Principal Data Analyst

**Principal Data Analyst**

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

About the Team

The Bank Tech Analytics team is a group dedicated to advancing data-driven decision-making and operational excellence across the enterprise, delivering comprehensive services for Bank Tech while actively contributing back to the broader organization. The team provides core capabilities spanning metrics and insights frameworks, applied analytics, operational efficiency automation, and AI integration. Through continuous stakeholder partnerships and automated data pipelines via Snowflake/Onelake and Databricks, Bank Tech Analytics transforms complex information into actionable insights and custom reporting solutions. This work enhances the developer experience, equips leaders to drive strategy, and delivers high-impact value by fostering enterprise-wide collaboration and pioneering innovative analytics transformations.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

**Innovation**

* Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
* Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
* Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

**Business Intelligence**

* Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
* Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

**Data Management**

* Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
* Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
* Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

**Our ideal candidate will have:**

* Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
* Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
* Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or, a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
* At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
* At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
* At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
* At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
* At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
* At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $131,300 - $149,800 for Principal Data Analyst  
New York, NY: $143,200 - $163,500 for Principal Data Analyst  
Richmond, VA: $119,400 - $136,200 for Principal Data Analyst

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please. Capital One

jobs.description:
**Wealth Management Opportunity in Financial Services**

**Senior Investment Operations Analyst**

Osaic has returned to the office on a hybrid schedule requiring a minimum of 4 days weekly in the office.

**Role Type:** Full time

**Summary:**

The Senior Investment Operations Analyst plays a critical role in building, automating, and scaling the firm’s investment infrastructure. This position leads complex operational analysis and supports portfolio management, reporting, data integrity, and systems integration across investment and advisory platforms. The role partners closely with Advisory, Investment, Service, Technology, and Compliance Teams to optimize workflows, strengthen reporting accuracy, and drive automation across the investment lifecycle. The Senior Investment Operations Analyst serves as a subject matter resource, independently resolves escalated issues, and contributes to strategic initiatives that improve operational efficiency, mitigate risk, and support scalable growth.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and oversee daily reconciliation processes across custodians, portfolio accounting systems (e.g., Black Diamond), and internal records to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely resolution of exceptions.
* Independently research and resolve complex cash, position, performance, and transaction discrepancies in coordination with custodians and internal stakeholders.
* Manage portfolio implementation workflows, including rebalancing support, account-level execution tracking, and escalation of operational exceptions.
* Monitor and validate data integrity across systems to ensure consistency among reporting, performance, CRM, and investment platforms.
* Prepare and maintain compliance- and audit-related documentation tied to trading, portfolio operations, controls, and issue remediation.
* Develop advanced Power BI dashboards, Excel-based models, and other analytical tools to deliver actionable investment and operational insights.
* Perform in-depth analysis of portfolio trends, liquidity, capital calls, cash flows, and private investment reporting.
* Identify trends, root causes, control gaps, and operational risks, and recommend practical solutions to management and business partners.
* Design and implement process improvements that automate manual workflows, including anomaly detection across cash flows, performance data, and account activity.

* Lead or support system integrations across CRM, portfolio accounting, reporting, and investment platforms, including requirements gathering, testing, and validation.
* Build and maintain scalable reporting dashboards, data models, and analytical tools that enhance decision-making and operational transparency.
* Establish repeatable processes and controls to normalize, structure, validate, and govern investment data.
* Contribute to data schema design, data optimization, platform enhancements, and other strategic initiatives.
* Lead operational workstreams supporting the integration and transition of acquired firm investment, account, and performance data.
* Provide guidance, knowledge sharing, and quality review support to team members; perform all other duties as assigned.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Education Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred. High School Diploma or equivalent (GED) is required.

**Basic Requirements:**

* 4-6 years of experience in investment operations, portfolio accounting, financial services, or a related analytical role.
* Demonstrated ability to independently analyze and resolve complex operational, data, and investment-related issues with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong experience working across technology platforms, translating business needs into practical process or system solutions, and adapting quickly to new tools.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working proficiency in SQL, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, and data validation.
* Experience developing and maintaining business intelligence and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience using Python, R, VBA, or similar tools for automation, data preparation, or analytical workflows.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience across core wealth management applications is strongly preferred (e.g., Black Diamond, Salesforce, CAIS, Preqin, YCharts, and Powder).
* Experience with private investment reporting, capital activity tracking, and alternative investment data, including platforms such as CAIS.
* Experience serving as a subject matter resource and partnering with advisors, clients, custodians, technology teams, or internal stakeholders in a platform- or systems-focused role.

**Company Overview**

Through its Social Innovation Business that brings together IT, OT(Operational Technology) and products, Hitachi contributes to a harmonized society where the environment, wellbeing, and economic growth are in balance. Hitachi operates globally in four sectors – Digital Systems & Services, Energy, Mobility, and Connective Industries – and the Strategic SIB Business Unit for new growth businesses. With Lumada at its core, Hitachi generates value from integrating data, technology and domain knowledge to solve customer and social challenges. Revenues for FY2024 (ended March 31, 2025) totaled 9,783.3 billion yen, with 618 consolidated subsidiaries and approximately 280,000 employees worldwide. Visit us at www.hitachi.com .

**About Hitachi Social Innovation**

Hitachi Social Innovation addresses the world’s most challenging social and environmental challenges. By focusing on more efficient usage of assets and systems, we extract value to reach outcomes that matter for business and society – what we call the double bottom line. Combining 100+ years of experience in operational technology (OT) and 60+ years in IT, we harness Hitachi’s broad capabilities in R&D to deliver cutting edge AI and IOT solutions in the core areas of transport, manufacturing and energy.

**Background**

At Hitachi ZeroCarbon, we envision a zero-carbon future for society. We are a venture incubation engine which builds innovative end-to-end decarbonization businesses to accelerate the transition to a greener, more efficient world for our customers and society.

Hitachi ZeroCarbon’s mission is to build billion-dollar potential businesses in the green economy to claim Hitachi’s potential as a climate change innovator, and to deliver on our mission to contribute to society. We incubate and build high-tech growth ventures at the intersection of mobility, energy and digital, enabling Hitachi to play a pivotal role in leading the net-zero transition.

**What you’ll be doing**

**Role Overview**

A typical challenge may start with a depot on a new path to electrification. We may help with up-front studies to define what infrastructure is needed, or deploy to an existing setup, assessing available site energy, accounting for existing loads, BESS, solar and local energy mechanisms. We may perform site audits and interoperability tests, t define appropriate hardware limits and deploy our software to most effectively maximise charging energy in live operation.

We remain connected to depots, during their operation, working with both charger and vehicle partners to ensure vehicles charge reliably, as well as providing recommendations on how to manage energy most efficiently on these sites. We perform root cause analysis and provide appropriate data to help customers fix issues and improve.

  

We are looking for a **Project Manager** to join the Operations Team. The role is rooted in project management but will be varied: supporting deployments, bids, site activity, service improvement and customer-facing technical understanding.

This would suit someone early-career or developing in project management, with curiosity, a technical mindset and confidence working across teams. You do not need deep specialism, but should enjoy understanding systems, challenging logic and moving work forward.

We want someone practical, enthusiastic, quick to learn, constructively challenging and comfortable balancing varied activities.

* Support customer project delivery, developing to own workstreams with senior support.
* Coordinate plans, actions, site readiness, customer packs, handovers and lessons learned.
* Support site activity with technical, electrical and service specialists, keeping actions, evidence and follow-up clear.
* Prepare bid and new-scope inputs: assumptions, risks, dependencies, lessons learned and evidence.
* Build operational understanding of charging faults, service issues and customer context.
* Improve service efficiency using AI tools, templates, trackers, repeatable processes and clearer reporting.
* Support governance, action tracking, stakeholder preparation, communication and escalation.
* Capture project learning for product, service, partner integration and future solution development.
* Work across Programme, Service Delivery, Product, Data Science, Commercial, Sales and Hitachi Energy teams.
Promote safe site activity through visit planning, hazard awareness, readiness checks and escalation routes.  

**What you will get involved in**

* Fleet electrification projects, including travel to assess and onboard bus and commercial vehicle depots.
* Charge management software, battery analysis, recommendations and customer service performance.
* Energy topics such as site capacity, BESS, solar, variable loads and future optimisation opportunities.
* Partner integrations across the wider eMobility ecosystem.
* Bid development, customer problem-solving and new-scope exploration.

We build the technology that powers billions of dollars in purchasing decisions, and we're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help lead that transformation. In this role you'll help advance procurement from individual AI-assisted productivity toward an operating model where AI increasingly supports and automates processes, with people orchestrating, verifying, and governing the work. We are recruiting all-source intelligence analysts at the Higher Executive Officer (HEO) grade to work in the new National Security Intelligence Assessment (NSIA) unit in UKHSAs Analysis and Intelligence Assessment (AIA) Directorate. We expertly fuse all sources of qualitative and quantitative information on UK and global health security threats and their drivers.

We provide insight and foresight to support Ministers, Chief Medical Officers (CMO), and policy and decision makers across Health and HMG; making impact every day.

This is an exciting time to join a growing UKHSA all-source assessment cadre, where you will join a fast-paced environment working across a variety of topic areas and continual opportunities for collaboration and improvement.

#### **Working for your organisation**

We pride ourselves as being an employer of choice, where Everyone Matters promoting equality of opportunity to actively encourage applications from everyone, including groups currently underrepresented in our workforce.

UKHSA ethos is to be an inclusive organisation for all our staff and stakeholders. To create, nurture and sustain an inclusive culture, where differences drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our workforce and wider communities. We do this through celebrating and protecting differences by removing barriers and promoting equity and equality of opportunity for all.

**Please visit our careers site for more information https://gov.uk/ukhsa/careers**

We draw on world-leading talent across a range of disciplines, including intelligence assessment, epidemiology, data science, statistical modelling and social research, to maximise impact through collaboration.

If not already, you will complete extensive training to join the Professional Head of Intelligence Assessment (PHIA) profession.

#### **Main duties of the job**

As a National Security Intelligence Analyst you will:

* Conduct intelligence analysis using structured analytic techniques to contribute to high-quality assessment products that provide UK decision-makers and policymakers with insight into a broad range of health security issues and their implications for the UK.
* Support the development of analytical products by researching, collating, evaluating and interpreting information from a wide range of sources, including complex and potentially conflicting information.
* Work closely with colleagues across AIA, UKHSA and wider government to support collaborative analytical projects and contribute to building effective working relationships with internal and external partners.

* Manage your workload effectively, delivering multiple tasks to agreed deadlines and escalating risks or challenges where appropriate.

Please Note, this list is not exhaustive.

### **Person specification**

* Professional experience as an all-source intelligence analyst OR a health or bioscience degree (or equivalent qualification) and professional experience in a bioscience or health field (which could be from a policy, diplomatic, technical, clinical, or professional academic background).
* Experience researching, evaluating and interpreting information from multiple sources to support analytical products, assessments, reports or briefings

jobs.title: Senior OSINT Analyst (Tech Against Terrorism)
jobs.description:
**Role:** Senior OSINT Analyst (Tech Against Terrorism)

**Location:** London (hybrid, 2 days per week)

**Reporting to**: OSINT Lead

**Role Type:** Permanent

**Salary:** £45,000 - £52,000 per annum, depending on experience  
  
Tech Against Terrorism aims to save lives and prevent harm by disrupting terrorist activity online and upholding human rights. We use open-source intelligence investigation, sophisticated technical tooling, and an established capacity-building apparatus for tech platforms to tackle terrorist activity online and counter the exploitation of digital spaces by terrorist and violent extremist (TVE) actors. We work closely with the United Nations, tech platforms, democratic governments, and civil society. We are seeking to scale our efforts to monitor and disrupt TVE exploitation of online spaces by expanding our established team of OSINT Analysts in hiring a Senior OSINT Analyst in the UK.  
  
Our flagship technical product is the Terrorist Content Analytics Platform (TCAP), an alerting system to report and record terrorist or violent extremist content found online. To date, the TCAP has alerted more than 130 tech platforms to over 30,000 pieces of terrorist material on their servers. As of 2024, the TCAP also operates an archive of terrorist content to permit researchers to access terrorist material in a secure and safe location, and provide a hash-sharing capability to assist platforms in content moderation.

**Please note we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must have full right to work in the UK in order to be considered.** Candidates will be expected to undertake and pass a police check and additional checks for **security clearance at an SC level,** which typically requires **a minimum of 5 years' continuous UK residency** immediately prior to application.

We are particularly interested in hearing from you if you have a professional background in:

* Developing and implementing OSINT tooling and technical solutions to problems relating to online harms
* Product management and development
* Data analysis, from collection to visualisation in order to extract actionable insights

**The role**  
  
Senior OSINT Analysts are TAT's investigative experts. They lead the complex investigations and projects that shape how partners understand the terrorist threat, set the standard for analytical rigour, and develop the next generation of analysts.  
  
You'll work with a **high degree of autonomy,** setting the direction of your own work and identifying where the team's effort is best focused, and you'll represent TAT with governments and tech platforms, and at external events and conferences.  
  
**Key responsibilities**

* Investigations: carry out **advanced OSINT and SOCMINT investigations** hands-on, design collection plans, and lead complex and sensitive investigations and intelligence requests, through to predictive assessments that inform stakeholder decisions.
* Collection priorities: direct collection priorities for other analysts, including across TCAP, and keep our datasets enriched and current.
* Reporting and quality: produce high-quality reporting for government and tech platform stakeholders, and provide senior quality control on others' reporting.
* Incident response: respond in real time to terrorist incidents with an online component, alerting platforms and relevant authorities, including as part of our on-call rota.
* Projects and procedures: lead funded projects end to end, triage priorities for yourself and others, contribute to proposals for new work, and develop workflows and SOPs.

* Tooling and safe practice: lead the testing and adoption of new tools and techniques, working with QuantSpark's technical teams, and advise colleagues on operational security and ethics.
* Representation: represent TAT with stakeholders and at conferences and external events, and contribute to strategic planning across the organisation.
* Developing the team: act as the team's expert in one or more threat areas or regions, supervise and guide analysts informally, design and deliver OSINT training, and identify where the team's skills need to develop.

**What you'll bring**  
**Essential**

* Typically 3 to 6 years' experience in open-source intelligence (OSINT) work in the public or private sector, including leading investigations or projects

jobs.title: Senior Threat Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Threat Analyst to join our rapidly growing Information Security team. This is a unique opportunity for a seasoned cyber security professional to be at the forefront of our cyber defence strategy, protecting our brand from existing and emerging threats. You will combine the expertise of a Threat Hunter and Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, and have the autonomy to help define our threat intelligence and hunting capabilities as our organisation continues to scale. You'll have a major input on what new tooling and services we use and the backing to implement this.

You'll be an innovative collaborator with strong technical skills, particularly in using KQL and excellent communication skills, with an appetite for complex problem solving. Seize the opportunity to join a dynamic security team, reporting to the Head of Cyber Defence, and lead the development of advanced CTI and threat hunting strategies, seamlessly integrating into our security processes and driving continuous improvements.

Our Future Health will be the UK’s largest ever health research programme, bringing people together to develop new ways to detect, prevent and treat diseases. We are a charity, supported by the UK Government, in partnership with charities and industry. We work closely with the NHS and with public authorities across all nations and regions of the UK.

Our plan is to bring together 5 million volunteers from right across the UK who will be asked to contribute information to help build one of the most detailed pictures we have ever had of people’s health. Researchers will be able to use this information to make new discoveries about human health and diseases. So future generations can live in good health for longer.

**What you’ll be doing**

In this role, your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

* Working closely with the wider information security team, including our MSP SOC, to improve the overall security posture of the organisation.
* Developing, implementing and utilising our cyber threat intelligence approach, including tooling and feeds.
* Maintaining a current understanding of the cyber threat landscape with a focus on the health research sector.
* Triaging, analysing, and responding to threat intelligence alerts from partners and other stakeholders.
* Tracking relevant threat actors, specifically their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Providing threat input to support the assessment of security risk and threat modelling activities of Our Future Health.
* Developing, implementing and iterating our threat hunting approach through use of cutting edge hunting techniques, including automation of aspects of the threat hunting process.
* Creating threat hunting hypotheses and performing threat intelligence led proactive threat hunts across the estate.
* Contributing to detection engineering initiatives by identifying opportunities for, and implementation of new detections and improvements to existing detections.
* Leveraging in-house knowledge to enrich and benefit the SIEM and SOC (e.g. managing Sentinel watchlists, assisting with triage, sharing knowledge of our technical estate with the MSP analysts, etc.)
* Assisting with incident investigation and insider threat monitoring.
* Producing written reports and providing verbal briefings which capture the relevance of cyber threats to Our Future Health to a variety of internal stakeholders.
* Supporting the Head of Cyber Defence in building out and maturing our broader threat capabilities.

  
**Requirements**

You will have some of the following skills and experience:

* Significant experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence.
* Significant experience in Threat Hunting.
* Experience with the Microsoft Sentinel SIEM/SOAR platform.
* Significant experience in writing KQL.
* Excellent understanding of threat intelligence principles and practices.
* Proven understanding of security risk management.
* Understanding of threat modelling.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001 and other commonly used security standards.
* Understanding of modern cloud technologies.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Ideally experience with the Microsoft Defender suite, Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Purview.
* Exposure to Agile working.

* Desire to be part of a small fast-paced team.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Jellycat Labs
jobs.description:
For a quarter of a century, the Jellycat family have brought joy, wonder and playful fun to people of all ages, in every part of the world. Utterly original and in a class of their own, they are currently among the most loved and collected toys of their kind. How has this gentle tribe endeared themselves to so many? Perhaps it is their whimsical expressions. Or the deliciously soft fabrics. Or the beautiful way in which they sit in your hand. Whatever it is, there is something magical and unmistakeable about each one of them.

Jellycat Labs is Jellycat's innovation division, working with factory, mill and research partners to bring automation, AI quality control and process innovation to how our products are made, contributing to the long term future of the Jellycat brand.

This role is for a highly organised and hands on Project Manager who thrives on getting into the detail of delivery. Working within Jellycat's Global Projects team and embedded in Jellycat Labs, the role takes ownership of Labs projects across automation, AI vision quality control, process innovation and enabling technologies, from initiation through to closure, applying Jellycat's project governance and methodology consistently and reliably.

Working directly with our Jellycat Labs team, the role requires an individual who can manage several concurrent projects at pace - translating requirements and plans into tangible progress, keeping stakeholders informed, and flagging risks and issues early.

The role spans a diverse portfolio, so the successful candidate will be equally comfortable running a feasibility study with a university or technology partner, taking a proof of concept through to a pilot, and running a trial at a partner factory through to handover to Production. They will adapt their approach to suit each project, applying stage gated, predictive and iterative techniques as appropriate.

This role is designed for someone who thrives on structured delivery, is comfortable managing multiple work-streams simultaneously, and takes pride in seeing a project through cleanly from kick-off to benefits realisation. The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and confident working directly with stakeholders at all levels to keep projects on track.

The role includes occasional travel to UK universities and research institutes and, as the role develops, opportunities to attend trade shows in Europe and Asia and visit our factory partners in Asia.

The Jellycat Labs Project Manager will manage projects across four core areas:

* **Automation and robotics:** fabric handling, single-ply separation and sewing automation, from feasibility through proof of concept to pilot cell.
* **AI vision quality control:** inspection trials and proofs of concept with technology vendors and integrators.
* **Process innovation with factory partners**: pilots and trials at partner factories in Vietnam, Indonesia and China, including data capture and line monitoring, with handover to Production on success.
* **Enabling technologies:** materials and process research such as gravimetric stuffing, 3D weft knitting and fabric inspection, run with mills, universities and specialist partners.

**You'll be:**

* **Project Delivery:** Taking ownership of assigned projects from initiation through to closure, developing and maintaining project plans, schedules and budgets, and ensuring delivery on time, within scope and to the agreed quality standard. Embracing hands-on involvement in all project phases, actively engaging with team members, stakeholders and vendors to maintain project momentum.
* **Governance & Methodology:** Applying Jellycat's project management methodology, templates and governance consistently, ensuring every project has a clear scope, business case, RAID log and benefits tracking, and progressing projects through agreed stage gates.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Building strong working relationships with project sponsors, business stakeholders and delivery partners, providing clear, regular updates on progress, risks and decisions needed.
* **Risk & Issue Management:** Proactively identifying, logging and managing project risks and issues, escalating promptly to Jellycat Labs leadership for decisions and to the Global Head of Projects for methodology and resourcing support.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Coordinating work across business, technical and third-party teams involved in each project, ensuring dependencies are understood and tracked, and that everyone involved knows what's expected of them and by when. This includes working closely with the Labs Senior Innovation Project Engineer in Vietnam and with Jellycat's Vietnam and Korea teams on factory-based trials and pilots.
* **Tailored Delivery Approach:** Selecting and tailoring the right delivery approach for each project, including stage-gated approaches for feasibility and pilot work, iterative and test-and-learn approaches for early-stage innovation, and agile or hybrid approaches for data and digital elements, while staying within Jellycat's governance framework.
* **Technical & Partner Coordination:** Working hand-in-hand with Jellycat's quality, production, sourcing, operations, product and technology teams, as well as external partners including factories, mills, universities, research institutes, technology vendors and integrators, to manage trials, samples, prototypes, testing and their dependencies.
* **Quality, Compliance & Readiness:** Ensuring each project meets the relevant quality, product safety, regulatory and technical standards, planning testing and validation activities and confirming operational readiness before handover to Production.
* **Uncertainty & Decision Points:** Managing projects with high levels of uncertainty by setting clear hypotheses, milestones and go/no-go criteria, and bringing the right evidence to sponsors so decisions can be made quickly.
* **Reporting & Continuous Improvement:** Owning the Labs master pro

jobs.description:
London Permanent - Full Time

On Site

  
  

#### **About us**

The Fidelis Partnership is a leading privately-owned, Bermuda-based Managing General Underwriter, which, through its subsidiaries, is a global underwriter of property, bespoke and specialty insurance and reinsurance products. The Fidelis Partnership is one of the largest Managing General Underwriters globally and its operations also include outwards reinsurance, claims handling, exposure management and portfolio analytics. **Data Quality**

* Review data quality exceptions, critical field failures and operational control outputs, ensuring errors are investigated, corrected and recorded in line with required standards.

* Work with outsourced providers to ensure data quality and performance targets are met, with issues identified, owned and addressed promptly.

**Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Support audit, SOX and governance requests by collating evidence, reviewing control outputs and ensuring actions are completed within agreed deadlines.
* Work closely with other Operations teams to support service delivery, backlog reduction, process consistency and achievement of agreed SLAs.
* Identify trends, recurring issues and process gaps, escalating these where appropriate and supporting practical improvements to reduce operational risk.

#### **Skills & experience**

* 3 years’ experience dealing with one of the following classes of business; Aviation, Marine, Property.
* 3 years’ experience dealing with one of the following policy types: excess of loss, treaty, delegated authority insurance policy types.
* A practical understanding of Underwriting systems.
* Basic competency in MS Office applications: Word and Adobe Standard required.

* Demonstrated ability to master new concepts quickly and take initiative with own personal development.
* Ability to develop relationships with key stakeholders both internal and externally across the Company.
* Must be able to self-lead and work effectively both independently and with teams.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver and manage accurate thoughtful detail-oriented work within tight deadlines.

**At The Fidelis Partnership, we aim to be different while making a difference.**

* We set the standard for quality in our industry. Guided by our expertise, our clients can take unique and material risks with confidence.

jobs.description:
£450 per day | Outside IR35 | 6-month contract

**Programme:** Open Front Door  
**Reports to:** Technology Architect and Project Manager

**About the Role**

This isn't simply a Salesforce implementation. It's an opportunity to transform how people access and experience vital support.

At Norwood, we've already taken an important step towards making our services easier to access. Through our Open Front Door programme, we've brought enquiries together through a single point of contact, supported by Salesforce and clear service standards.

Now we're ready for the next phase.

We're looking for an experienced Business Analyst (Salesforce & Service Transformation) to lead the business analysis and help transform how our Children and Family Services manage referrals, assessments, support plans and ongoing service delivery.

Currently, our teams work across Unite, spreadsheets and manual trackers. We're moving to Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, creating a more connected approach to case management, with SharePoint supporting the management of case documentation.

Your role will be to bridge the gap between how services operate today and how they need to work tomorrow.

You'll spend time with frontline colleagues, understanding the realities of their work, identifying what needs to change and translating those requirements into clear, practical solutions for our Salesforce implementation partner.

But your involvement won't end when the requirements are documented.

You'll stay close to delivery, from discovery and process design through to data migration, testing, training and go-live, ensuring the solution works for the people who will use it.

This is a six-month, outside IR35 assignment for someone who enjoys getting close to the detail, challenging assumptions and delivering change that makes a difference.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You'll be an experienced, hands-on Business Analyst who understands that successful technology transformation starts with understanding the people, processes and services behind the system.

You'll have delivered CRM or case management implementations from discovery through to go-live, with strong practical experience of Salesforce.

You'll know your way around cases, queues, assignment rules, reporting and dashboards, and you'll have the technical understanding to work confidently with an implementation partner, challenge proposed solutions and ensure requirements are properly understood.

Just as importantly, you'll know how to work with people who aren't technical.

You'll be comfortable sitting alongside frontline colleagues, asking the right questions and turning complex or inconsistent processes into clear requirements that both service managers and developers can understand.

You'll bring structure without unnecessary bureaucracy, recognising when detail is essential and when a pragmatic decision will keep delivery moving.

You'll also understand that a successful implementation isn't measured simply by whether the system goes live, but by whether people can use it confidently and whether it improves how services operate.

Experience within children's services, social care, SEND, health or the charity sector would be particularly valuable, although strong transferable experience is equally welcome.

**Your Day to Day**

You'll take ownership of the business analysis activity across the transformation, working closely with service leaders, frontline teams, the Technology Architect, Project Manager and Salesforce implementation partner.

Your work will include:

* Discovery and process mapping: Work with Children and Family Services, Transition and Adult Services to understand existing workflows, identify gaps and agree future processes.
* Requirements and solution design: Translate service needs into clear business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritised delivery backlogs.
* Salesforce implementation: Work closely with the implementation partner, challenging proposed solutions and ensuring the system meets agreed business requirements.
* End-to-end case management: Help design processes covering referrals, triage, assessments, support plans, appointments, therapy, courses, payments and onward referrals.
* Transitions and safeguarding: Ensure the solution supports young people's transitions into Adult Services, safeguarding oversight and appropriate access to sensitive information.
* Data migration: Define what needs to move from Unite and existing spreadsheets into Salesforce, including data cleansing, mapping and ownership.
* Document management: Work with the relevant teams to define how SharePoint documents connect with Salesforce, including structure, naming conventions and permissions.
* Reporting and insight: Define the dashboards, KPIs and management information needed to monitor service performance, outcomes and quality.
* Family self-service: Support the development of functionality that enables families to manage appointments, view service information and update their details.
* Testing and quality assurance: Develop and coordinate user acceptance testing, manage defects and ensure the solution is ready for implementation.
* Training and adoption: Develop practical training materials, support colleagues and help ensure the new processes become embedded in everyday working.
* Project governance: Maintain clear documentation, decision logs, risks and issues, providing regular progress updates and supporting effective change control.
* You'll be expected to balance the detail of business analysis with the pace and priorities of a live transformation programme.

**Essential**

You'll bring:

* A degree-level qualification or extensive equivalent experience in a similar role.
* Demonstrable experience delivering business analysis for CRM or case management implementations, from discovery through to go-live.
* Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, particularly cases, queues, assignment rules, reports and dashboards.

The position coordinates with network engineering, cybersecurity, acquisition, finance, logistics, contracting, 61 CS, and site leads to deliver mission-critical capabilities within established scope, schedule, budget, operational, and Special Access Program (SAP) security constraints.

Working under the direction of the IT Project Manager or designated military lead, the Assistant IT Project Manager provides delegated project-management support throughout the full project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and controlling, and closeout. Responsibilities include supporting network modernization, software and hardware acquisition, lifecycle replacement, implementation, and transition-to-operations activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinates multi-site network infrastructure projects encompassing software and hardware procurement, licensing, installation, system cutovers, and lifecycle sustainment.
* Partners with Information System Security Officers and Managers (ISSO/ISSMs) and network engineers to ensure procurements and deployments comply with Risk Management Framework (RMF) controls, Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and SAP-specific authorization requirements.
* Develops and coordinates communications plans and approval packages for Concepts of Operations (CONOPS), synchronizing with the Office of Special Investigations (OSI), National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), Aerospace, and facility security stakeholders to ensure projects involving Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) modifications meet critical security requirements.
* Prepares and coordinates acquisition and funding documentation, including CIPS requests, market research, independent government estimates, procurement directives, and supporting contract packages.
* Supports financial planning, forecasting, budget execution, and prioritization of IT infrastructure requirements.
* Maintains end-to-end project oversight by tracking schedules, milestones, funding status, procurement packages, vendor lead times, deliveries, licenses, warranties, asset handoffs, and site-readiness requirements.
* Ensures project artifacts and communications are handled, stored, and disseminated through approved channels in accordance with applicable access, need-to-know, handling, records-management, configuration-management, and release procedures.
* Prepares project status reports, executive dashboards, risk updates, and decision briefings for project leadership and senior stakeholders.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Active TS/SCI clearance and SAP eligibility required.
* Associate's or bachelor's degree in information technology, project management, computer science, business, or a related field.
* Three to five years of progressively responsible experience supporting IT projects, project management, or project operations.
* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise IT infrastructure, network modernization, software, hardware, and lifecycle-management projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project schedules, procurements, risks, dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholder coordination.
* Experience working in a Department of War or comparable secure environment.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Project Management Institute (PMI) Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) or CompTIA Project+ certification preferred.
* CompTIA Security+ or Network+ certification preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of secure network environments in classified domains.
* Experience with facility configuration, site readiness, and coordination with security and facility authorities.
* Familiarity with Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid project-management methodologies.
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile, Scrum, or comparable project-management certification preferred.

**Why Vision IT?**

At **Vision IT**, we lead with **People First**, ensuring our employees and customers thrive. We foster a culture grounded in **integrity, compassion, and excellence**, empowering our teams to deliver critical IT solutions that support national defense missions.

We prioritize your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package, including:

We are dedicated to supporting your health, well-being, and long-term financial goals.

In addition to federal law requirements, Vision IT complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. jobs.title: Lead Marketing Data Analyst (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
**Vos missions**
----------------

Nous recherchons un(e) Lead Marketing Data Analyst pour rejoindre l'équipe B2B Performance Marketing. En tant que Lead Marketing Data Analyst, vous êtes la référence analytique de l'équipe sur la performance d'acquisition, l'attribution et la valeur client.  
  
Vous transformez des données cross-canal complexes en concepts clairs et en recommandations concrètes qui influencent directement les décisions d'investissement, de ciblage et de croissance de l'équipe. Vous êtes le socle data sur lequel s'appuient le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et le Digital Analyst : vous garantissez que la bonne donnée est disponible, fiable et exploitable par tous.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Data Product Managers pour trouver les bonnes solutions et aligner les équipes Data sur des définitions communes, des métriques partagées et une structuration cohérente de la donnée. Vous êtes également le partenaire des Sales Operations (équipe SCOPS) pour construire l'infrastructure de “lead scoring” qui connecte Marketing et Sales.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement AI-first : les modèles ML, les pipelines automatisés et l'analyse assistée par IA feront partie de votre quotidien.  
  
**Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :**

1. Attribution, parcours de conversion & incrémentalité (30%)

* Piloter le modèle d'attribution multi-touch de l'équipe entre SEO, acquisition payante et CRM
* Construire et maintenir une vue unifiée des parcours de conversion, exploitable depuis le data warehouse
* Définir et documenter les définitions de conversion communes sur lesquelles toute l'équipe s'aligne
* Accompagner les équipes Paid et CRM dans la mesure de leur impact (tests d'incrémentalité, Marketing Mix Modeling, Causal Impact…)
* Travailler avec les Data Product Managers pour s'assurer que les modèles de données et les flux associés sont correctement structurés et maintenus

2. LTV/SAC, analyses de cohortes & reporting à la Direction (25%)

* Suivre la LTV et le SAC par canal d'acquisition, segment et cohorte
* Construire et maintenir les courbes de rétention par cohorte (J7, J30, J90) et identifier les moments de churn
* Déterminer quelles sources d'acquisition et quels segments génèrent la plus forte valeur à long terme
* Développer des modèles de prévision en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Data et Finance
* Produire le reporting LTV/SAC mensuel qui guide les décisions d'allocation budgétaire et préparer les synthèses de performance partagées avec la Direction

3. Scoring des leads & partenariat avec les équipes commerciales (20%)

* Concevoir et déployer un modèle de scoring des leads basé sur le machine learning avec l'équipe SCOPS, pour déterminer quels leads sont transmis aux commerciaux et lesquels sont nurturés en CRM
* Traduire les données comportementales et d'engagement en un modèle de scoring activable dans le CRM, en coordination avec le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI
* Faire évoluer le modèle au fil des nouvelles données et des retours des équipes commerciales

4. Disponibilité de la donnée & support de l'équipe (15%)

* Être le partenaire data du spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et du Digital Analyst : garantir que la donnée dont ils ont besoin est disponible, bien documentée et fiable
* Traduire leurs besoins en exigences structurées pour les Data Product Managers
* Identifier les problèmes de qualité de données en amont et les suivre jusqu'à leur résolution
* Être le lien entre l'équipe Performance Marketing et l'organisation Data

5. Tableaux de bord opérationnels & suivi de la performance (10%)

* Piloter les tableaux de bord de performance globale de l'équipe : acquisition, attribution, LTV/SAC et contribution par canal (suivi quotidien, pilotage hebdomadaire, vue mensuelle pour la direction)
* Mettre en place une détection automatique des anomalies, des synthèses narratives générées par IA et des analyses exploratoires assistées pour libérer du temps sur des travaux analytiques à plus forte valeur ajoutée

**Les qualités attendues pour ce poste**
----------------------------------------

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

* Justifiez de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience en analytics marketing, growth analytics ou business analytics idéalement dans des scale-ups B2B SaaS
* Avez l'habitude de piloter un travail analytique de bout en bout, du modèle de données à la présentation à la Direction
* Maîtrisez les requêtes SQL de manière autonome au quotidien et avez travaillé directement avec BigQuery ou équivalent
* Avez une expérience concrète en attribution et/ou en incrémentalité : vous avez construit ou piloté un modèle d'attribution multi-touch, mené des tests d'incrémentalité (user-based, geolift) ou travaillé sur du Marketing Mix Modeling
* Avez une expérience en optimisation du funnel marketing :

  + Stratégie d'acquisition & d'activation
  + Modélisation de la LTV / SAC dans un contexte SaaS ou par abonnement : avoir réalisé des analyses LTV et SAC basées sur des cohortes, utilisées pour orienter l'allocation budgétaire ou des décisions stratégiques.
  + Définition des KPIs et cadre de référence (MQLs, SQLs, Leads...)
* Expérience avec des outils de visualisation de données : Amplitude, Tableau, Looker, Metabase…
* Maîtrisez l'anglais et le français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral

Ce serait fantastique si vous aviez aussi :

* Des compétences en Python ou R pour la modélisation statistique avancée et le développement de modèles de machine learning
* Une connaissance des modèles de croissance tirés par le produit (product-led growth) et de la façon dont les données d'usage alimentent la mesure marketing
* Une expérience de management ou d'accompagnement d'analystes plus ju

**About Us**:

CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility. We are a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, it’s been Catalyst Mobility’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. Catalyst Mobility works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. Catalyst Mobility provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

**About The Role**:

As Lead Project Manager, Equitable Electric Mobility, you will help Catalyst Mobility drive equitable zero-emission transportation policies and programs across our priority states. This role will live within Catalyst's Innovative Mobility team, and your primary focus for the upcoming year will be managing operational and program activities within the Towards Equitable Electric Mobility (TEEM) Community of Practice, a collaborative initiative between Catalyst Mobility and The Greenlining Institute.

In this role, you will work with TEEM partners on setting strategic direction in alignment with Catalyst Mobility's broader organizational goals. You will work in close partnership with The Greenlining Institute to deliver hands-on coordination, capacity building, and peer-learning opportunities for a cohort of state-based environmental and equity organizations. You will help execute multi-state project goals, track deliverables, administer program budgets, handle reporting, and oversee efforts to attract additional funding for this work. You will ensure aligned campaign execution across state lines to build support for a national agenda for equitable electric mobility.

**What You'll Do**:

**Stakeholder Engagement & Program Support**:

* Support relationship management and strategy development with key program funders, coalition leaders, and aligned national campaign partners.

**What You'll Bring to the Table**:

------------------

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

**About the Role**
------------------

OpenLoop’s mission is to bring care anywhere by powering telehealth solutions at scale. Our Technical Program Management team turns business vision into structured, measurable execution, bringing operational rigor, predictability, and scale to how OpenLoop plans and ships. We’re hiring a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional programs that directly support company OKRs and strategic priorities.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role and one of the most senior TPM positions at OpenLoop. You will help set direction for how OpenLoop plans, prioritizes, and delivers its most complex, multi-team programs, translating business vision into structured, executable technical programs. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders, run Agile delivery across engineering teams, and make sure every initiative is tied to measurable outcomes.

You will help lead the build-out of the TPM function at OpenLoop in standardizing Agile and practices, defining reporting cadences, and providing delivery metrics that improve how teams plan and ship. You will act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, presenting in stakeholder and leadership meetings with C-level visibility and meaningful ownership. You will lead through influence, setting the standard for program leadership and growing the next generation of TPMs at OpenLoop. You will connect engineering and product with the rest of the business so that priorities move forward predictably.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own and drive execution of complex, cross-functional technical initiatives tied directly to company OKRs.
* Ensure every request from business stakeholders aligns with company objectives and measurable outcomes.
* Make prioritization and tradeoff decisions in partnership with Engineering and business leaders, negotiating across scope, timelines, and impact.
* Produce status reports and updates tailored to the audience: executive summaries for leadership, detailed delivery views for engineering, and updates for business partners.
* Own cross-team planning, dependency management, and delivery cadence across multiple engineering teams.
* Use metrics and retrospective findings to find bottlenecks and improve team efficiency, predictability, cycle time, and delivery health, and communication.
* Set program strategy, consistent operating model cadence engineering and product, including quarterly planning, program reviews, and multi-quarter roadmaps across portfolios of related initiatives, aligned to company OKRs.
* Define the TPM operating model at OpenLoop, including standards for intake, planning, prioritization, reporting, and delivery health.
* Lead organizational change, such as new delivery practices, tooling, or team structures, and bring stakeholders along.
* Lead delivery during high-stakes moments, such as critical launches, client escalations, or incidents, keeping teams focused and stakeholders informed.
* Run a consistent operating cadence across engineering and product, including quarterly planning, program reviews, and launch readiness checks.
* Provide program data on capacity and resourcing to inform headcount planning, architecture reviews, and portfolio discussions.
* Keep TPM documentation and onboarding materials current so the practice runs as a repeatable discipline, not on any one person's knowledge.

**Who You Are**
---------------

### **Required Qualifications**

Our client, a nonprofit, Department of Defense-funded advanced-manufacturing consortium, needs a Program Manager to oversee a portfolio of subcontracted technology development projects. You won't build the project plans yourself. You'll manage the external teams who do, keeping each project on scope, schedule, and budget. This is a fully remote, 8–12 month W-2 contract with up to 25% travel.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead kickoffs and set cost, schedule, and performance baselines for each subcontracted project.
* Run a twice-monthly cadence with each performer: a technical deep dive and a PM-to-PM action review.
* Track milestones, blockers, and deliverables against contract requirements.
* Validate expense allowability, approve invoices and cost share, and submit monthly spend plans.
* Maintain a risk register and escalate high-impact issues in real time.
* Lead program reviews and travel for site visits and demonstrations.
* Write briefs and status reports that translate technical progress for government stakeholders.
* Manage change requests and project closeout.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of program management, including oversight of multiple external performers or subcontractors.
* Defense program experience, including briefing government stakeholders.
* Hardware or hardware/software development background, ideally starting in engineering.
* Industry experience delivering technology toward market or field use.
* U.S. citizenship; based in the Eastern or Mountain time zone.
* Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills.

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Robotics, automation, or manufacturing experience.
* Federal cost-share and accrual tracking.
* Navy program experience.
* Familiarity with Jira and other PM tools; PMP.

You run your own programs with light mentoring, earn credibility with engineers on teams you don't manage, and raise problems early.

The Industrial Controls Program Management team is part of the Industrial Controls organization, which is responsible for developing, deploying, and supporting controls products, software, and systems for Symbotic’s automated warehouse solutions. * Proven experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder release schedules, site maintenance windows, and structured change management protocols.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a demonstrated ability to align engineering, software quality assurance, and 24/7 site operations teams.

With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world's most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

### **Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst,** **Advanced Cybercrime and Engagements Team, Insikt Group, Recorded Future**

**Location:** Remote USA (Preference for Boston, MA or Washington, DC)

**The Role:** You will research and analyze criminal activity on dark web/underground platforms, such as forums, shops, marketplaces, and secure communication channels, to identify cybercrime trends and threat actors. You will also help identify sources, maintain persistence on those sources, and interact with threat actors to obtain information not publicly available. You will be engaged in proactive research, with the flexibility to respond to requests from Recorded Future colleagues and customers related to cybercriminal activities. You will use open-source intelligence (OSINT), internal tools such as the Recorded Future Intelligence Operations Platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) to inform customers and internal stakeholders about the latest cybercriminal threat activities and trends, ensuring timely, actionable insights.

new_jobs.description:
Risk Adjustment Data Analyst
  
Position Summary
  
The Risk Adjustment Data Analyst supports end to end risk adjustment and revenue cycle operations by analyzing HCC submissions by ArchWell Health and any rejections at Clearninghouse/payer/CMS level, managing chart retrieval and review workflows, and ensuring accurate ingestion of care gap and clinical documentation data for various sources. This role is critical to maintaining RAF accuracy, reducing submission errors, and enabling continuous monthly reconciliation across MA programs. The role requires flexibility to perform additional tasks as needed, especially as risk adjustment and quality requirements evolve across markets and programs.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
HCC Reconciliation & Submission Validation
  

* Perform monthly validation of all HCC submissions (MAO004, encounters, claims, sweeps).
* Analyze payer acceptance, rejections, and 277CA/999 acknowledgement files.
* Identify new, recaptured, and dismissed HCCs and reconcile against internal systems (VIM, HCC engine).
* Present and route any rejections/gaps for appropriate teams.

Sweeps & Payer Data Management
  

* Review sweeps datasets to ensure completeness, accuracy, and payer acceptance.
* Support ASM workflows and monitor acceptance/rejection trends.
* Track payer healthcare gaps and validate alignment with internal care gap logic.

Chart Retrieval & Review Support
  

* Build and maintain chart retrieval/review prioritization rules (1LR, 2LR, external providers).
* Monitor chart retrieval programs, turnaround times, and vendor performance.
* ROI analysis of various programs
* Manage unlinked charts and ensure proper linkage to members, service dates, and HCCs.

Care Gap & Clinical Data Ingestion
  

* Support ingestion/analysis health plan care gap files and ensure accurate mapping into VIM and analyze suspects conversion rate from various sources.
* Validate care gap completeness and partner with clinical teams to ensure data is actionable.
* Develop or refine member stratification logic for outreach and in home visit prioritization.

Reporting & Analytics
  

* Build/Maintain dashboards and reports to track HCC operations work inclusive of reconciliation, chart retrieval progress, and rejection trends.
* Provide insights to leadership on productivity, throughput, and operational bottlenecks at market/center/payer level.
* Support continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and recommending process enhancements.

Cross Functional Collaboration
  

* Work closely with Operations, RCM, Coding, Clinical Documentation, Vendor partners, and IT/Data teams.
* Participate in governance meetings to review trends, exceptions, and payer specific issues.
* Ensure alignment across teams to reduce sweeps level escalations and maintain steady state workflows.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, Public Health, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in risk adjustment, RCM, healthcare analytics, or payer operations.
